engine: A small diesel truck engine idling steadily, a low rumbling putter, constant, no revving, about 4 seconds, seamless loop
horn: A toy truck horn: two short friendly honks, beep beep, about 1 second
load: Gravel pouring from a hopper into a metal truck bed, a short rattling rush that fills and stops, about 1.5 seconds
dump: A dump truck tipping its load: hydraulic whine then a heavy pile of gravel and rocks sliding out and thudding on the ground, about 2 seconds
dig: An excavator bucket scooping into dirt and gravel: one crunchy scrape with a hydraulic hiss, about 1 second
pour: Wet concrete sloshing down a metal chute, thick gloopy pouring, about 1.5 seconds
smash: A heavy wrecking ball smashing into a brick wall: a deep thud, crumbling bricks falling, about 1.5 seconds
collapse: An old brick building collapsing: a long rumbling crash of bricks, timber and dust settling, about 3 seconds
place: A heavy steel beam being lowered into place: a solid metallic clank and a satisfying ratchet click, about 1 second
miss: A cartoon miss: a springy wobbling boing going down in pitch, about 1 second
scoop: Rocks clattering into a metal loader bucket, one short scoop, about 1 second
crush: A rock tumbling into a stone crusher: a short crunchy grinding crack and a puff, about 1 second
bump: A toy truck bumping into a wall: a dull hollow plastic and metal thud, about half a second
poof: A cartoon magic poof: a quick soft whoosh and pop, about half a second
roll: A heavy steel road roller drum pressing fresh asphalt: a short low crunchy squish, about half a second
fanfare: A short triumphant cartoon fanfare: bright brass ta-da with a xylophone run and a cymbal, about 3 seconds
cheer: A small crowd of happy children and townsfolk cheering and clapping: hooray!, about 3 seconds
click: A chunky plastic button click, one short clean click
